# Hubgentic

> {{ en.meta.description }}

Hubgentic is an AI consultancy and product studio based in Italy, working with small and mid-sized companies (SMEs) and early-stage startups in Italy and abroad, in Italian and English. It is operated by Complify PTE. LTD. (Singapore).
